sellerProduct.description:
This rare 7" vinyl single by The Chemical Brothers, released in 1999 on the Freestyle Dust label, is a must-have for any fan of electronic music from the 90's. The high-fidelity record features the tracks "Out of Control" and "Shell Shock" in stereo, showcasing the band's signature Big Beat style. Housed in a cardboard sleeve with a paper sleeve grading, this limited edition jukebox release is perfect for a special occasion like a birthday. Made in the United Kingdom, this vinyl is a collector's item for dance and electronica enthusiasts.
